events.text: Is that real-time ray tracing on the puddles?
Going to do the yellow thing.
Ammo. I don't have a gun yet, but ammo.
I can see the paint. I can't reach the paint.
Is that... a bit of yellow? Okay...
No yellow... but the waystone is RIGHT THERE.
I did it! All by myself!

profile.intro: Brilliant writer, 30 years in the industry. Nobody has ever told him he can't jump.
